lastPrompt:
RECOMMENDATIONS — job recommendations-2026-11-06. Find ideas that move the product strategy, where we have a gap.
1. set_title "Recommendations · 2026-11-06". set_stage research. Read knowledge/product-strategy/BRIEF.md (goals and KPIs), knowledge/product-strategy/RESEARCH_SOURCES.md, knowledge/research/CHANGELOG.md (what changed in the research Figma folder), COMPETITOR_RESEARCH.md, the journey audits and SURFACES.md.
2. Research: open the research files in Figma that the changelog lists as new or updated (get_metadata / get_screenshot, read only), Mobbin for peer flows, and capture_site our own routes to see what we have today. Before calling something a gap, check the live site really lacks it.
3. Pick the 3 strongest gaps. For each, write specs/recommendations-2026-11-06/ideas/<idea-slug>.md:
   - Gap: what peers do / what users need that we don't (with screenshots and sources).
   - Strategy: which BRIEF.md goal and KPI it moves, and why.
   - Business case: expected impact (with the assumption behind each number), effort S/M/L, risk, how we'd measure it.
   - Scope: MVP vs later, surfaces and routes, Lumen components reused, Lumen gaps.
   - Mock: a DRAFT on the real shell at apps/live-site/app/prototype/idea-<idea-slug> (same rules as proposals: real components, no redrawn chrome), captured at 1440 and 390.
4. Call studio.submit_recommendations with the list (title, summary, goal, impact, effort, mock screenshots, file) and end your turn. Chris turns the ones he likes into projects.
Never clone a peer's look; translate into Lumen.

ideas.title: Live payout tracker
ideas.summary: The homepage promises 'Payouts within minutes', but a withdrawal has no status after it's requested: Withdraw just redirects and Transactions rows have no status field. We already track deposits live. Add a 4-step status card (Requested → Approved → Sent → Arrived) with an ETA above Transactions, plus status pills on withdrawal rows.
ideas.goal: Trust enabler · Initiative 08 (#10, #50) · Trust contacts ~27.6K/6 mo → half (BRIEF 'Now': live payout status/time)
ideas.impact: ~4–5.5K fewer contacts per 6 months (15–20% of baseline), assuming 30–40% of trust contacts are withdrawal-status chasers and the tracker deflects half. CX tags needed to confirm.
ideas.effort: M (the UI is S; the work is the payments status feed)

ideas.title: First-week path
ideas.summary: New players get no plan for days 2–7. Missions exist, but only as a generic list inside VIP Hub. A 7-day strip at the top of the logged-in homepage gives one expiring step a day with its reward visible; Day 1 is the first casino bet. Claims use the existing mission claim sequence.
ideas.goal: Activate + Reward · Initiatives 01/04/05 (#6, #15, #18, #25) · Week-one retention 50% → 65%; also time to first casino bet
ideas.impact: +3–6 pts week-one retention on fast starters, to be proven with a holdout. Blended cost ~$8–12 per new player, assuming 20–30% finish all 7 days.
ideas.effort: M (fixed 7-step script on the existing missions model; personalised steps need #46/#47 later)

ideas.title: Casino Tournaments
ideas.summary: The casino sidebar's 'Tournaments' links back to /casino and tiles tagged Tournament lead nowhere. Our only competitive mechanic is the volume-based Daily Race. In the team's new benchmark, 85% of peers put tournaments in the lobby. Add short, game-specific events (best multiplier, streak) with pot, timer, live rank and Play, starting on Originals.
ideas.goal: Reward bet + Discover · Initiative 04 (#19, #20) · Casino churn window ~30 → 60 days
ideas.impact: 8–12% of weekly casino actives join weekly (to be checked against Daily Race participation), and joiners' 30-day retention +5–10 pts vs matched non-joiners. Cost-neutral: part of the race pot moves into shorter events.
ideas.effort: M for an Originals-only MVP; L for third-party slots
